
:::{#exr-bernoulli-likelihood-general}

Let $\vy$ represent a data set of
mutually [independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt) [binary outcomes](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/data.html#def-binary-var),
each with a potentially different event probability $\pi_i$:

$$
\ba
\vy &= (y_1, ..., y_n)
\\
y_i &\simind \Ber(\pi_i)
\ea
$$

Derive the [likelihood](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-lik) of $\vy$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-likelihood-general}

$$
\ba
\red{\pi_i} &\eqdef \P(Y_i=1)
\\ \P(Y_i=0) &= 1-\red{\pi_i}
\\
\P(Y_i=y_i) &= \P(Y_i=1)^{y_i} \P(Y_i=0)^{1-y_i}
\\
&= (\pi_i)^{y_i} (1-\pi_i)^{1-y_i}
\\
\red{\Lik_i(\pi_i)} &\eqdef \P(Y_i=y_i)
\\
\Lik(\vec \pi) &\eqdef \P(\dsvn{Y}{y})
\\
&= \prodin \P(Y_i=y_i)
\\
&= \prodin \red{\Lik_i(\pi_i)}
\\
&= \prodin (\pi_i)^{y_i} (1-\pi_i)^{1-y_i}
\ea
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

{{< include _subfiles/logistic-regression/_thm-bernoulli-lik-general.qmd >}}

{{< slidebreak >}}

{{< include _subfiles/logistic-regression/_exm-bernoulli-lik-general.qmd >}}

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exr-bernoulli-loglik-general}

Derive the [log-likelihood](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-loglik) of $\vy$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-loglik-general}

$$
\ba
\llik(\vpi) &\eqdef \logf{\Lik(\vpi)}
\\
&= \logf{\prodin \Lik_i(\pi_i)}
\\
&= \sumin \logf{\Lik_i(\pi_i)}
\\
&= \sumin \llik_i(\pi_i)
\\
\llik_i(\pi_i) &\eqdef \logf{\Lik_i(\pi_i)}
\\ &= y_i \logf{\pi_i} + (1-y_i) \logf{1-\pi_i}
\ea
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

{{< include _subfiles/logistic-regression/_thm-bernoulli-loglik-general.qmd >}}
